session.zh: 跨市场更新 · 美国劳动节

headline.zh: 财报强，休市日不做方向判断。
headline.en: Strong earnings, but no market call on a holiday.

summary.zh: 美国股市因 Labor Day 休市。本次更新不填造价数据，而是把研究重心放在最近已披露业绩：云与 AI 收入增长继续强劲，但资本开支、供给约束与自由现金流转换仍是下一阶段最重要的验证项。
summary.en: US equities are closed for Labor Day. This update does not invent a price signal; it focuses on recent results instead. Cloud and AI revenue remain strong, while capex, supply constraints and free-cash-flow conversion are the next key tests.

title.zh: 盈利兑现有证据，估值方向留给下一个交易日。
title.en: Earnings have evidence; leave valuation direction to the next trading day.

detail.zh: Alphabet、Microsoft、Apple 的最新披露均显示核心业务与 AI 需求仍具韧性；腾讯则呈现“广告/云增长与 AI 基础设施投入同步加速”的特征。休市日不把基本面信息误写成市场价格信号。
detail.en: Recent disclosures from Alphabet, Microsoft and Apple show resilient core businesses and AI demand. Tencent shows advertising/cloud growth alongside faster AI infrastructure spending. A holiday is not a price signal.

detail.zh: NYSE 在 2026 年 9 月 7 日劳动节休市，没有美国现货股票收盘数据。
detail.en: NYSE observes Labor Day on September 7, 2026; no US cash-equity close is available.

detail.zh: Alphabet 披露 Google Cloud 营收同比增长 82%，由企业 AI 基础设施与解决方案带动。
detail.en: Alphabet reported Google Cloud revenue up 82% YoY, led by enterprise AI infrastructure and solutions.

detail.zh: 腾讯加大 AI 基础设施投入；研究问题已转向这笔投入的回报，而非仅仅需求。
detail.en: Tencent stepped up AI infrastructure investment; the research question is now return on that spend, not only demand.
